<div class="site-wrap inner-page">
 <header class="page-intro"><p class="eyebrow">RESEARCH SOFTWARE</p><h1>Models built for<br><em>better decisions.</em></h1><p class="page-intro-lede">An evolving suite of research tools designed to connect plantation processes with environmental and economic assessment.</p></header>
 <section class="software-list">
  <article class="software-feature"><div class="software-index"><span>01</span><div class="software-icon">3PG</div></div><div><p class="eyebrow">PROCESS-BASED SIMULATION · RESEARCH STAGE</p><h2>3PG-RubPalm</h2><p class="software-lede">A process-based modelling framework for oil palm and rubber plantation systems.</p><p>Model components address productivity, canopy development, biomass allocation, carbon dynamics, water balance, and responses to climate and management scenarios.</p><div class="tagline"><span class="topic-tag">R</span><span class="topic-tag">3PG modelling</span><span class="topic-tag">Climate scenarios</span><span class="topic-tag">Yield &amp; carbon</span></div><p class="small-note">Model name in the doctoral workflow: 3PG_RubPalm_V1.0_Modular. A public code repository has not yet been linked.</p></div></article>
  <article class="software-feature"><div class="software-index"><span>02</span><div class="software-icon">GHG</div></div><div><p class="eyebrow">ENVIRONMENTAL ACCOUNTING · RESEARCH STAGE</p><h2>LiRubPalm-GHG App</h2><p class="software-lede">A plantation-focused greenhouse-gas accounting and scenario-assessment application.</p><p>The application is being developed to examine greenhouse-gas emissions, removals, emission intensity, land-use implications, and the social cost of greenhouse-gas emissions.</p><div class="tagline"><span class="topic-tag">R Shiny</span><span class="topic-tag">GHG accounting</span><span class="topic-tag">Life-cycle perspective</span><span class="topic-tag">Scenario analysis</span></div><p class="small-note">An independently hosted public Shiny demonstration can be added when deployment and data permissions are finalized.</p></div></article>
  <article class="software-feature"><div class="software-index"><span>03</span><div class="software-icon">DSS</div></div><div><p class="eyebrow">INTEGRATED DECISION SUPPORT · UNDER DEVELOPMENT</p><h2>3PG-RubPalm Liberia DSS</h2><p class="software-lede">An integrated environment for comparing management and climate-adaptation pathways.</p><p>Planned decision outputs combine biological productivity, economic performance, carbon and greenhouse-gas indicators, and user-weighted sustainability priorities.</p><div class="tagline"><span class="topic-tag">Multi-criteria assessment</span><span class="topic-tag">Management pathways</span><span class="topic-tag">Decision science</span></div><p class="small-note">The framework is research software in development; this page does not imply public production readiness.</p></div></article>
